With the filtering of the alignment for phylogeny, it has 
become short (150 bp), but with a significant decrease in N and gaps.

In the old analysis, we first ran Gblocks here, but later we 
considered it necessary to run it for phlogeny as well. Since the 
alignment is now clean, we simply visualize it and move on to the haplotype network.

## Haplotype extraction and plotting 
We are gonna use the R package geneHapR, by @Zhang2023.

```{r hapnetlist, collapse = TRUE, warning=FALSE, figure.align = "center", fig.height=5, fig.width=12}
suppressWarnings(library(geneHapR))
suppressWarnings(library(stringr))
suppressWarnings(library(Biostrings))
suppressWarnings(library(ape))
suppressWarnings(library(DECIPHER))
suppressWarnings(library(pegas))
suppressWarnings(library(RColorBrewer))
suppressWarnings(library(plyr))
suppressWarnings(library(htmltools))

CrepiCOI <- readDNAStringSet("../2023-10-02/GB/Cox1_Cfar_ASM_align.fa-gb1")
## Remove thos sequences with les than 50% of data
CrepiCOI <- CrepiCOI[rowSums(alphabetFrequency(CrepiCOI)[,1:4]) > 100]
CrepiCOI <- subseq(CrepiCOI, start = 30, end = 140)
BrowseSeqs(CrepiCOI, htmlFile = "CrepiCOI_HN.html")
includeHTML("CrepiCOI_HN.html")

hapResults <- seqs2hap(CrepiCOI, na_drop = FALSE)
hapSummary <- hap_summary(hapResults)

hapList <- as.data.frame(hapSummary[, c("Hap", "freq", "Accession")])
f <- which(is.na(hapList$freq))
hapList <- hapList[-c(1:4), ]
hapList$Accession[1:3] <- str_split(hapList$Accession[1:3], ";")
hapList$Accession[1][[1]]
hapList

AccINFO  <- data.frame(lake = substring(names(CrepiCOI), 1, 1))
AccINFO$lake <- revalue(AccINFO$lake, c("L" = "Langfjordvatn", "S" = "Suohpatjávri"))
row.names(AccINFO) <- names(CrepiCOI)
hapNet <- get_hapNet(hapSummary, 
                     AccINFO = AccINFO)


# Not draw alternative links (wis btw?)
altlink <- attr(hapNet, "alter.links")
#altlink

hapNet2 <- hapNet
attr(hapNet2, "alter.links") <- NULL
attr(hapNet2, "alter.links")

```

```{r haploNet}

Lakes = c("yellow2", "royalblue")
par(mar = c(1, 5, 5, 1))
tiff(filename = 'Crepi_Haplo_03.tiff', width = 3200, height = 2800, units = "px", res = 300)
#png(filename = 'Crepi_Haplo_02.tiff', width = 3200, height = 2800, units = "px", res = 300)
plotHapNet(hapNet2, 
           labels = TRUE, backGround = Lakes, 
           col.link = 1, link.width = 1, 
           show_color_legend = TRUE, legend = c(1, 8))
dev.off()

plotHapNet(hapNet2, 
           labels = TRUE, backGround = Lakes, 
           col.link = 1, link.width = 1, 
           show_color_legend = TRUE, legend = c(1, 8))
```

```{r tests, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}

plotHapNet(hapNet2,
           size = "freq", 
           scale = "log10", 
           labels = TRUE, backGround = Lakes,
           show.mutation = 1, 
           legend=FALSE, cex=1)

plotHapNet(hapNet2,
           size = "freq", scale.ratio = 1,
           scale = "log10", 
           labels = TRUE, backGround = Lakes,
           xlim = c(-20,10), #ylim = c(-10,10), 
           col.link = 1, link.width = 1,  pie.lim = c(1, 4),
           show.mutation = 1, 
           show_color_legend = TRUE, legend = c(-28, 12), cex=10)
```
